name: AionUi

overview_markdown:
AionUi is a free, open-source desktop 'Cowork' application (macOS, Windows, Linux) that provides a unified graphical interface for running OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and 20+ other CLI agents. Rather than being an agent itself, it acts as a control plane: users can customize assistants, team multiple agents together, manage parallel sessions, and keep automations running 24/7 with remote access. It ships with a built-in agent and supports any API key, aiming for zero-setup onboarding.

Architecturally it is a TypeScript/Electron-style app backed by an 'aioncore' service, with recent work focused on a VS Code-like explorer (file tree, SCM/changes panel with repo re-discovery), conversation state management (distinguishing streaming vs. waiting-for-user states), desktop notifications, and a WebUI bridge with hardened websocket reconnection logic. The project is heavily localized (13+ languages) and maintains an active release cadence (v2.2.2 as of September 2026).

Compared to OpenClaw itself, AionUi is complementary rather than competitive: OpenClaw is the locally-running assistant with deep chat-channel integrations, while AionUi wraps OpenClaw and its peers in an accessible GUI for non-technical users and multi-agent workflows. Its 33k+ stars and trending status indicate strong adoption, though its security and sandboxing posture is less documented than its UX features.
